tasks.enabler_now: The supplied evidence concerns production records, not a replacement for this physical task.

tasks.human_edge: Inspect actual conditions and intervene appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Machine care and flow adjustment remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Production data collection does not demonstrate replacement of physical coolant control.

Record mill production on the schedule sheet

tasks.enabler_now: Native production records can assemble counts and operator entries into a shift record.
tasks.still_hard: Matching counter resets, scrap and interrupted runs to the correct job.

tasks.altitude: Less copying onto schedule sheets; context capture and acceptance stay human.

evidence.claim: MPDV HYDRA X collects produced quantities and machine statuses from controls or manual entries.
Sintex replaced hand-collected data and spreadsheet compilation with machine data capture; its reported efficiency change is not this operator's recording-time saving.
This task's labour estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is mill production recording, excluding machine operation, physical counts where needed and supervisor analysis.

Machine controller produces raw count, timestamp and machine id; operator verifies reset boundaries and captures job id, shift, good quantity, scrap quantity, reason codes and corrections during s1. All capture remains in s1. Missing controller data are manually read and entered, not treated as zero.
Configuration administrator maps machine ids and job fields; six other-role incremental hours below cover added maintenance. Initial mapping is included in integration and rollout.

Test native OPS_SYSTEM forms and schedules first. Existing runtime earns no saving; only repeated sheet copying is removed. Confirm national consultation and access requirements before operator-linked logging.
